(i) the most widely used two color cDNA microarrays are not well suited to the study of differential gene expression in small sample sets, such as the 10 to 20 cell lines or 10 to 30 patients in a typical cancer study; and (ii) the use of single color, high density short (25-mer) oligonucleotide microarrays is an effective alternative to two color cDNA arrays for this type of research.
